_comment: TB-direct read-plane test fixture (design §5). Mirrors the shape TB returns from GET /api/tenant/deviceInfos?textSearch=... — a PageData { data:[deviceInfo], hasNext, totalElements } — deviceInfo carries the `active` boolean (OOHDASH-80: plain /api/tenant/devices omits it, which is why online status was always false). Plus the per-device latest-telemetry shape { key:[{ts,value}] } from GET /api/plugins/telemetry/DEVICE/{uuid}/values/timeseries. Keyed by tbName so tests can look up telemetry by device. The 6261 set includes a bleed neighbour (gk-62611) and a numeric-bleed drop (gk-62091) so the anchored client-side filter is exercised. Names carry realistic C4 exception classes.
